# P3 · AI-drafted notes under clinician review — R3 · Scribe

**Window:** Weeks 13–20 · 18 Jan 2027 → 12 Mar 2027  
**Delivered to:** 5–10 opt-in clinicians under clinical review  
**Day one:** Record a consented consultation on phone or desktop, review a draft note with evidence links, correct it and sign.  
**Goal:** Medvya drafts the note from the conversation; the doctor checks each statement against its source and signs. Nothing AI-generated is saved without explicit approval.

**Tickets:** 27 · **Estimate:** 57.5 dev-days vs **40 working days** in the window (OVER by 17.5 days: needs scope trade-off or overlap) · **Average confidence:** 80%

**Status:** To do 27

| MDV-P3-E01 | Recording consent and policy | P3-01 | Per-encounter consent separate from treatment consent; decline and revocation always safe. |

## Exit criteria (release gate)

- [ ] 0 fabricated medicines or doses across the evaluation set — [MDV-P3-018](MDV-P3-018.md), [MDV-P3-027](MDV-P3-027.md)
- [ ] ≥ 80% of drafts signed with only minor edits (clinician rated) — [MDV-P3-026](MDV-P3-026.md), [MDV-P3-027](MDV-P3-027.md)
- [ ] Consent recorded for 100% of recordings; declined path tested — [MDV-P3-003](MDV-P3-003.md), [MDV-P3-027](MDV-P3-027.md)
- [ ] Clinician trust survey and note time compared with P2 baseline — [MDV-P3-026](MDV-P3-026.md), [MDV-P3-027](MDV-P3-027.md)

**Not in this phase:** Wearable clip, earpiece assistant, Arabic–Hindi–Malayalam mixed-language notes (P6).
